title: An engineer rebuilds himself
description: A weapons-maker is captured, survives thanks to a device in his chest, and turns his own technology away from war and into a suit of armor.

title: A weapon with a gem inside
description: A powerful scepter carrying a glowing gem is used to control minds, and its true nature is not yet understood.

title: A guardian mind turns hostile
description: An attempt to build an artificial intelligence to protect the world instead produces one that decides humanity is the threat.

title: A benevolent synthetic being awakens
description: A new synthetic being is created and awakens on the heroes' side, with the same glowing gem set into its brow.

title: The gems are gathered
description: The scattered gems are finally brought together, granting the power to erase half of all living things at once.
